biography: Jake Rattenbury, a name synonymous with raw aggression and unwavering commitment in the Ginetta racing scene, hails from the unassuming town of Market Rasen, Lincolnshire. His journey began not on the track, but on the muddy fields of his family's farm, where he honed his reflexes chasing rogue sheep on a souped-up quad bike. It was during these youthful escapades that his innate feel for vehicle control and his fearless approach to speed began to blossom. At age 19, Jake stumbled upon a local Ginetta racing event and was instantly hooked. Borrowing money from his grandmother, he bought a battered Ginetta G40 and entered his first race, finishing a surprising third and immediately setting tongues wagging. Rattenbury quickly gained a reputation as a hard-charging, no-nonsense racer, unafraid to mix it up in the corners. However, as he approaches his late thirties, the spark seems to be fading. While flashes of brilliance still emerge, consistency has become an issue, and whispers of retirement are growing louder.
drivingStyle: Rattenbury's driving style is best described as 'controlled chaos'. He's known for his late braking and aggressive corner entries, often pushing the limits of adhesion. His tire management is, generously, 'enthusiastic', prioritizing immediate pace over long-run conservation. Under pressure, Rattenbury tends to double down on his aggression, sometimes leading to spectacular overtakes, but also to costly errors. He thrives in wet conditions, where his raw car control and unwavering commitment give him a distinct advantage.

rivalries.name: Marcus Thorne
rivalries.reason: A long-standing rivalry stemming from a controversial collision at Brands Hatch in 2018, where Rattenbury was deemed at fault, costing Thorne the championship.

rivalries.name: Isabelle Dubois
rivalries.reason: A clash of styles – Dubois' precise, methodical approach is the antithesis of Rattenbury's 'send it' philosophy, leading to frequent on-track battles and occasional off-track barbs.

rivalries.name: Callum 'Cal' Parker
rivalries.reason: A budding rivalry fuelled by Rattenbury accusing Parker of blocking during qualifying at Donington Park, leading to a heated exchange in the paddock.

quirks: Always wears the same pair of lucky socks, even though they're threadbare and smell questionable.
Listens to the same heavy metal track ('Ace of Spades' by Motorhead) before every race.
Has to adjust his helmet strap exactly seven times before getting in the car.
careerHighlight: Winning the 2017 Ginetta GT4 Supercup Championship after a season-long battle with Marcus Thorne, decided in a nail-biting final race at Silverstone.
careerLowPoint: Crashing out of the lead on the last lap of the 2020 Ginetta GT4 Supercup race at Thruxton, handing the victory to Isabelle Dubois and effectively ending his championship hopes that year.
